translation.title: Piroxicam Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used to relieve the pain and inflammation of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, humeral epicondylitis (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain (myositis, fasciitis, etc.), and post-traumatic swelling and pain, and related conditions and symptoms.
translation.usage: Adults apply 1 g (about 3 cm) to the affected area 3 to 4 times a day and rub in gently so that it is well absorbed.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or have reacted to it before, if you have aspirin-induced asthma or have experienced it, if you have developed hives, rhinitis, or angioedema with aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, in children 14 years or younger, or if you are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding. Before using it, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have bronchial asthma, are elderly, or are hypersensitive to or have had an allergic reaction to propylene glycol. Do not use it on skin with lesions (bleeding skin disorders, eczema, infected lesions, burns, wounds), or on the eyes or mucous membranes. Do not use an occlusive dressing. If the skin is damaged, use may cause a temporary stinging sensation, so use with care. Stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist if you develop local itching, redness, rash, scaling, eczema or dermatitis, contact dermatitis, erythema, or rarely photosensitivity.
